title: Aṅga
text: 2. Cattārimāni bhikkhave sotāpattiyaṅgāni || katamāni cattari || || 3. Sappurisasaṃsevo saddhammasavanaṃ yonisomanasikāro dhammānudhammapaṭipatti || || 4. Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni || || Sagāthakapuññābhisandavaggo pañcamo || || Tassa uddānaṃ || || Abhisandena tayo vuttā || Duve Mahaddhanena ca || Bhikkhu Nandiya Bhaddhiyam || Mahānām-Aṅgena te dasā ti || || CHAPTER VI. SAPPAÑÑAVAGGO CHAṬṬHO.
